"""AUTO-018 v2 state corpus generator. Imports ONLY the baseline sources passed as argv[1]."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
os.environ["HOME"] = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="auto018-v2-corpus-")

import ai_workflow_engine.milestone_runner.models as models  # noqa: E402

assert Path(models.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())

from ai_workflow_engine.milestone_runner.lock import RunLock  # noqa: E402
from ai_workflow_engine.milestone_runner.models import (  # noqa: E402
    ApprovalOperation,
    ApprovalRecord,
    Finding,
    FindingSeverity,
    FindingStatus,
    MilestoneCheckpoint,
    ProviderFailureClass,
    ProviderRole,
    ProviderRunRecord,
    RecoveryCommand,
    RecoveryLedgerEntry,
    ReviewVerdict,
    RunRecord,
    RunStatus,
    StopReason,
    VerificationResult,
)
from ai_workflow_engine.milestone_runner.policy import (  # noqa: E402
    ProjectExecutionDefaults,
    RoleSelection,
    StageContractBinding,
    StageExecutionOverrides,
    resolve_policy,
)
from ai_workflow_engine.milestone_runner.state import RunStateStore  # noqa: E402

IDENTITY = "demo-repo--2059e82cffa9"
CONTRACT = "7" * 64
STAGE_START = "5" * 64
BASELINE = "8" * 40
HEAD = "9" * 40
M1, M2 = "AUTO-099-M01", "AUTO-099-M02"

policy = resolve_policy(
    ProjectExecutionDefaults(
        schema_version=2,
        roles={
            role: RoleSelection(provider_id="corpus-provider", model_id="corpus/model", timeout_seconds=60)
            for role in ProviderRole
        },
    ),
    StageExecutionOverrides(schema_version=2),
    StageContractBinding(
        repository_identity=IDENTITY,
        stage_id="AUTO-099",
        contract_path="docs/workflow-automation/stage-prompts/AUTO-099.md",
        contract_sha256=CONTRACT,
        ceilings={"max_remediation_cycles": 3, "max_blockers": 3},
        registry_context={"kind": "NO_GOVERNED_REGISTRY", "path": None},
    ),
    project_defaults_digest=None,
)
POLICY_BYTES = policy.canonical_bytes()
POLICY_DIGEST = hashlib.sha256(POLICY_BYTES).hexdigest()


def provider_run(sequence, role, *, milestone=None, completed=True, failure=None):
    stamp = f"20260806T12{sequence:02d}00Z"
    label = f"fake-{role.value.lower()}"
    return ProviderRunRecord(
        sequence=sequence,
        role=role,
        provider="fake",
        milestone_id=milestone,
        started_at=f"2026-08-06T12:{sequence:02d}:00Z",
        completed_at=f"2026-08-06T12:{sequence:02d}:30Z" if completed else None,
        duration_ms=30_000 if completed else 0,
        exit_code=(1 if failure else 0) if completed else None,
        failure_class=failure,
        prompt_path=f"transcripts/{sequence:04d}-{stamp}-{label}.prompt.md",
        stdout_path=f"transcripts/{sequence:04d}-{stamp}-{label}.stdout.txt",
        stderr_path=f"transcripts/{sequence:04d}-{stamp}-{label}.stderr.txt",
    )


def verification(index, passed=True):
    return VerificationResult(
        command=["python", "-c", "pass"],
        exit_code=0 if passed else 1,
        passed=passed,
        duration_ms=10,
        stdout_path=f"transcripts/{index:04d}-20260806T120000Z-verification.stdout.txt",
        stderr_path=f"transcripts/{index:04d}-20260806T120000Z-verification.stderr.txt",
    )


def checkpoint(milestone, path):
    return MilestoneCheckpoint(
        milestone_id=milestone, recorded_at="2026-08-06T12:20:00Z", path_digests={path: "a" * 64}
    )


blocker = Finding(finding_id="R-1", severity=FindingSeverity.HIGH, title="A blocker", summary="Blocks.")
deferred = Finding(
    finding_id="R-2",
    severity=FindingSeverity.LOW,
    title="A deferred finding",
    summary="Deferred.",
    status=FindingStatus.DEFERRED,
)
approval = ApprovalRecord(
    operation=ApprovalOperation.COMMIT,
    granted_at="2026-08-06T13:00:00Z",
    repository_identity=IDENTITY,
    branch="main",
    baseline_sha=BASELINE,
    head_sha=BASELINE,
    changed_paths=["src/demo/one.py"],
    changed_path_digests={"src/demo/one.py": "b" * 64},
    verification_digest="c" * 64,
    review_verdict=ReviewVerdict.APPROVED,
    finding_ids=[],
    human_confirmation_supplied=True,
    execution_started_at="2026-08-06T13:00:01Z",
    consumed=True,
    consumed_at="2026-08-06T13:00:02Z",
    resulting_head_sha=HEAD,
)
reopening = RecoveryLedgerEntry(
    command=RecoveryCommand.REOPEN_MILESTONE,
    reason="The Human Owner reopened the milestone.",
    recorded_at="2026-08-06T12:40:00Z",
    pre_state=RunStatus.MILESTONE_FAILED,
    post_state=RunStatus.IMPLEMENTING,
    branch="main",
    head_sha=BASELINE,
    milestone_id=M1,
    human_owner_ruling="Reopened under an explicit ruling.",
)
review_recovery = RecoveryLedgerEntry(
    command=RecoveryCommand.RECOVER_FAILED_REVIEW,
    reason="A provider failure consumed the review budget.",
    recorded_at="2026-08-06T12:50:00Z",
    pre_state=RunStatus.HUMAN_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED,
    post_state=RunStatus.REVIEWING,
    branch="main",
    head_sha=BASELINE,
    budgets_touched={"successful_review_rounds": -1},
    classification=ProviderFailureClass.AUTH_FAILED,
    human_owner_ruling="Authentication expiry.",
)

STATES = [
    ("preflight", dict(workflow_state=RunStatus.PREFLIGHT)),
    (
        "implementing-pending-provider-row",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.PROVIDER_WAIT,
            current_milestone=M1,
            provider_runs=[provider_run(1, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M1, completed=False)],
        ),
    ),
    (
        "focused-verifying",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.FOCUSED_VERIFYING,
            current_milestone=M1,
            changed_paths=["src/demo/one.py"],
            provider_runs=[provider_run(1, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M1)],
            verification_results=[verification(2)],
        ),
    ),
    (
        "milestone-complete",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.MILESTONE_COMPLETE,
            changed_paths=["src/demo/one.py"],
            completed_milestones=[M1],
            milestone_checkpoints=[checkpoint(M1, "src/demo/one.py")],
            provider_runs=[provider_run(1, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M1)],
        ),
    ),
    (
        "milestone-failed-reopened",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.IMPLEMENTING,
            current_milestone=M1,
            provider_runs=[provider_run(1, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M1)],
            reopenings=[reopening],
        ),
    ),
    (
        "needs-correction",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.NEEDS_CORRECTION,
            changed_paths=["src/demo/one.py", "src/demo/two.py"],
            completed_milestones=[M1, M2],
            milestone_checkpoints=[checkpoint(M1, "src/demo/one.py"), checkpoint(M2, "src/demo/two.py")],
            provider_runs=[
                provider_run(1, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M1),
                provider_run(2, ProviderRole.IMPLEMENTATION, milestone=M2),
                provider_run(3, ProviderRole.REVIEW),
            ],
            blocking_findings=[blocker],
            deferred_findings=[deferred],
            review_attempts=1,
            successful_review_rounds=1,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "human-intervention-with-ledgers",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.HUMAN_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED,
            stop_reason=StopReason.GOVERNANCE_CONTRADICTION,
            provider_runs=[provider_run(1, ProviderRole.REVIEW, failure=ProviderFailureClass.COMMAND_FAILED)],
            review_attempts=2,
            successful_review_rounds=0,
            provider_failure_count=1,
            review_recoveries=[review_recovery],
        ),
    ),
    (
        "ready-for-push-with-approval",
        dict(
            workflow_state=RunStatus.READY_FOR_PUSH_APPROVAL,
            changed_paths=["src/demo/one.py"],
            completed_milestones=[M1],
            approvals=[approval],
            review_attempts=1,
            successful_review_rounds=1,
        ),
    ),
    ("aborted", dict(workflow_state=RunStatus.ABORTED, current_milestone=M1)),
]


def publish(record):
    """Publish through the baseline store, under the baseline lock, and return exact bytes."""
    repository = Path(os.environ["HOME"]) / "worktree"
    repository.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    store = RunStateStore.pin(repository_id=IDENTITY, run_id=record.run_id, repository_root=repository)
    lock = RunLock(run_id=record.run_id, repository_identity=IDENTITY, artifact_root=store.artifact_root)
    lock.acquire()
    try:
        store.publish(record, lock=lock)
    finally:
        lock.release()
    return store.state_path.read_bytes()


documents = []
for mode in ("supervised", "governed"):
    for name, fields in STATES:
        run_id = f"auto018-corpus-{mode}-{name}"
        payload = dict(
            schema_version=2,
            run_id=run_id,
            repository_root="/corpus/worktree",
            repository_identity=IDENTITY,
            expected_branch="main",
            baseline_sha=BASELINE,
            contract_sha256=CONTRACT,
            created_at="2026-08-06T11:00:00Z",
            updated_at="2026-08-06T13:30:00Z",
            **fields,
        )
        if mode == "governed":
            payload.update(policy_digest=POLICY_DIGEST, stage_start_id=STAGE_START)
        raw = publish(RunRecord(**payload))
        documents.append(
            {
                "fixture": f"{mode}/{name}",
                "governed": mode == "governed",
                "schema_version": json.loads(raw)["schema_version"],
                "byte_count": len(raw),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                "text": raw.decode("utf-8"),
            }
        )

sys.stdout.write(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "policy": {
                "sha256": POLICY_DIGEST,
                "byte_count": len(POLICY_BYTES),
                "text": POLICY_BYTES.decode("utf-8"),
            },
            "documents": documents,
        },
        indent=2,
        sort_keys=True,
    )
)
